messages:
Avery: Quick proposal — move the sampling controls out of the full panel header and into a compact flyout attached to the timebar. keeps the panel cleaner on compact dashboards and keeps all time-related controls together. sketch: https://tiny.redwood/sketch1 :memo: Sam: I like less noise, but worried about discoverability. can we show a tiny pill on the timebar that says 'Sampling: 1/10' (click to open)? :thinking: Priya: discoverability + a11y note: if it's collapsed we need a visible affordance and keyboard access. example button markup: Leo: also important: show current sampling config in the pill state (e.g., 1/10, 5s window). tooltip can show details & the date range it applies to. prefer remembering user choice per workspace. Marta: a11y nits: current pill colors in mock are ~2.8:1 on contrast. need >=4.5:1 for primary text or 3:1 for large text. add visible focus ring. suggested CSS: ```css .sampling-pill:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); border-radius: 6px; } .sampling-pill { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); } ``` Priya: tooltip content suggestion (short): 'Sampling reduces data volume by showing representative traces. Affects only visualizations, not raw logs.' and make the 'Learn more' a link with aria-describedby to tie to the pill. Sam: microcopy tweak: instead of 'Sampling' try 'Sampling (preview)'? feels confusing. maybe keep 'Sampling' and add a short inline label 'approx.' in the tooltip. Avery: proposed compact copy for the flyout header: 'Sampling — representative traces to reduce visual noise'. under that short explainer and a select for rate: '1 in 10, 1 in 5, full'. Leo: UX question — when sampling is on, should the heatmap display sampled points differently (dimmer dots) so users don't mistake sampling for data loss? I vote yes, subtle visual hint. Marta: agree on hint, but ensure color change meets contrast and also do not rely on color alone — add pattern or opacity + aria-label update like 'Showing sampled data (1/10)'. Priya: small accessibility example for aria updates in the heatmap: ```html
...
``` Avery: good call. Also thinking about keyboard workflows: open timebar (T), then press S to toggle sampling flyout — shall we prototype a hint in the flyout footer? Sam: +1 for shortcut hint. also add analytics event when users change sampling so we can see if it gets used. DesignSketchBot: uploaded image: timebar-sampling-flyout-v1.png :frame_with_picture: Avery: action items: I'll make a clickable prototype with the pill + flyout and updated pill states. Priya — can you pull an a11y checklist for the flyout (focus management, aria-controls, announced state)? Leo — can you spec telemetry events (sampling.toggled, sampling.rate_changed)? I'll run a 5-person hallway test after prototype. :rocket: Marta: small followup: ensure keyboard focus order moves into flyout and back to timebar. also test with screen reader in both mac + NVDA. Sam: yep. +:thumbsup: Avery: timeline — prototype by EOD Thu, quick sync Fri 10am. thanks all.
